also: put it back where you found it

evidence: Cic. Att. 11.24.2: sēpōnī et occultārī (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: put away in order, put back in its place
terms.comment: Of things put back where they belong when the work is done: Fortunata will not sit down to dinner until she has put the silver away.

phrases.english: Put these away in the cupboard.

phrases.latin: Patellās in armārium repōne, catīnōs in pluteum.
phrases.english: Put the plates away in the cupboard and the bowls on the shelf.

phrases.latin: nisi argentum composuerit, nisi reliquiās puerīs dīvīserit, aquam in ōs suum nōn conjiciet
phrases.english: until she’s put away the silver and shared out the leftovers among the slaves, she won’t put a drop of water in her mouth

phrases.latin: Cubōs et pūpās in cistam repōne.
phrases.english: Put the blocks and the dolls away in the box.
Put it back where you found it.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 34, 367.
